mentions.note: club 60m hurdles record 8.12 winning AAA indoor title

photos.c: Centre right: Yet another competitor in the Manchester Games, long jumper/sprinter/hurdler Sarah Claxton scored heavily for the club in Southern League competition. She has had a terrific indoor season, reducing the club record for 60m hurdles to 8.12 in winning the AAA Championship.
